result.title: Pano2BIM: A Geometry-Constrained Vision-Language Agent for As-Built BIM Generation from a Floor Plan and a Single 360$^\circ$ Image
result.summary: Digital twins require accurate, up-to-date building information models (BIM) that reflect physical conditions, yet generating and maintaining as-built models remains costly and labor-intensive. Emerging image-based methods can capture visual appearance without inherently producing structured BIM information, while vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with reliable metric object placement. This paper presents Pano2BIM, a geometry-constrained VLM agent that generates approximate IFC4 models at Level of Development (LOD) 200 from a floor plan with known room dimensions and a single 360-degree photograph. The VLM identifies landmarks and objects, while deterministic tools estimate camera pose, compute metric positions through ray casting, and check spatial constraints. An optional second stage enriches the presentation model through render-and-compare feedback without modifying the primary furniture geometry. In a preliminary evaluation on one laboratory, the proposed Measure workflow achieved a mean furniture-footprint intersection over union (IoU) of 0.53, compared with 0.44 for a single-response baseline using identical modeling instructions, and matched an average of 4.0 versus 2.3 of seven fixed furniture elements across three runs. Centroid disagreements were similar for the four elements consistently identified by both approaches. The measurement stage averaged 3.8 minutes and USD 1.63 in API costs per run, while the complete demonstrated workflow required approximately 42 minutes and USD 11. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of rapid, low-cost as-built BIM generation, with potential applications in maintaining digital twins that reflect changing physical conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Pano2BIM，一个几何约束的 VLM agent，从平面图与单张 360° 图像生成 LOD200 的 IFC4 模型：VLM 识别地标与物体，确定性工具负责相机位姿估计、射线投射度量定位与空间约束检查，另有可选的渲染比对增强阶段；单实验室初步评测中 Measure 流程家具足迹 IoU 为 0.53，优于单次响应基线的 0.44。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「VLM 只做语义识别、度量推理外交给确定性工具并配 render-and-compare 反馈」的分工可供核查，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取、验证回路与停止决策的设计提供方法线索；但论文不研究 latent 推理状态本身。
